correctness.rationale: For the four-qubit path graph, exact stabilizer reductions give pair mutual informations \(1,1,0,0,0,0\), so the source-normalized arithmetic quantity is \(1/3\). Endpoint \(Z\)-measurement leaves a pure measured qubit and a three-qubit path graph on every branch; the remaining three pair mutual informations are all \(1\), so every branch has value \(1/2\). The average therefore increases by exactly \(1/6\). The standalone exact-rational checker reconstructs these spectra and returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The result settles a motivated structural question for the exact mutual-information arithmetic functional at the first register size beyond the follow-up's three-party proof. It identifies a mechanism, not merely a numerical violation: endpoint measurement converts correlations invisible in most two-qubit marginals of the four-qubit path into three simultaneous pair correlations. The exact \(1/3\to1/2\) increase therefore gives a reusable boundary example for pairwise-correlation-based entanglement quantifiers.
